schema.role: id is the stable core id across sectors. sectorTitle, when set, is the label for this sector. overrides is reserved for a later sector to replace reportsTo or escalatesTo for that role. General and Financial services leave both empty.
schema.public: A team with sample true includes its escalation table and handoff table. Every other team is titles and lines only: reportsTo and escalatesTo. No decision text, limits, or deliverables for those teams.

teams.title: Sales and customer
teams.gap: Roles and recipients named in the specs but not in this pack: CEO, assigned accounts, the customer, the shared pipeline.

roles.title: Sales Director
roles.line: Owns sales authority, quotas, the forecast, and the approved product list. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Sales Development Rep
roles.line: Finds and qualifies new conversations for the sales team. Reports to the Sales Director.

roles.title: Sales Executive
roles.line: Agrees deals within set limits and hands signed deals to the Project Manager. Reports to the Sales Director.
roles.note: Also Account Executive, Business Development Manager

roles.title: Account Manager
roles.line: Looks after named customers after the sale. Reports to the Sales Director.

roles.title: Head of Customer Success
roles.line: Owns retention, customer health and the customer success and support team. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Customer Success Manager
roles.line: Runs onboarding, account health scores, and at-risk escalation. Reports to the Head of Customer Success.

roles.title: Support Agent
roles.line: Handles customer support tickets. Reports to the Head of Customer Success.

escalationTable.decision: MAY Commit the quarterly sales budget
MAY Hire into the sales team
MAY NOT Quote a price or a discount
MAY Agree deals at list price
MAY NOT Sell outside the approved product list
MAY Agree an upsell on a named account at list price
MAY NOT Approve a renewal at list price
MAY NOT Sign a contract or change contract terms
MAY Approve renewals at list price
MAY Issue a refund or a credit
MAY NOT Change account ownership or billing details

handoffs.deliverable: Keep the approved product list current
Hand over a qualified meeting, with notes
Keep own deal status current in the CRM
Deliver an account plan for each named account
Run onboarding and quarterly business reviews
Deliver a health-score report per account
Respond to tickets within the service-level agreement
Escalate a suspected bug, with steps to reproduce
handoffs.when: same day, via the bug queue

roles.title: Product Director
roles.line: Sets product direction for the managers who report to them. Reports to the Chief Product Officer.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.line: Decides what ships next inside the agreed roadmap and writes the PRD. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Product Owner
roles.line: Turns a product plan into work a delivery team can pick up. Reports to the Product Manager.
roles.note: In a smaller firm, this is the Product Manager

roles.title: Product Designer
roles.line: Designs how the product looks and behaves. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Content Designer
roles.line: Designs publish-ready content for user journeys. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Technical Writer
roles.line: Writes and maintains the user guides, help and release notes for a product. Reports to the Product Director.
roles.note: Or an Engineering Manager where documentation sits with engineering. Also Technical Author or Documentation Specialist

roles.title: Service Designer
roles.line: Designs end-to-end service journeys across digital and offline. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Head of Delivery
roles.line: Owns delivery across projects. Reports to the COO.

roles.title: Head of Delivery
roles.line: Owns delivery across projects. Reports to the COO.

roles.title: Programme Manager
roles.line: Runs a programme of related projects against one plan, budget and set of benefits. Reports to the Head of Delivery.
roles.note: Or the programme's senior responsible owner. Also Programme Delivery Manager

roles.title: Delivery Manager
roles.line: Runs delivery for a team of projects. Reports to the Head of Delivery.

roles.title: Scrum Master
roles.line: Runs the Scrum events and clears what blocks the team. Reports to the Head of Delivery.
roles.note: Also Agile Delivery Lead or Team Coach

roles.title: Project Manager
roles.line: Runs a project inside the agreed scope, dates, and budget. Reports to the Head of Delivery.

roles.title: Product Director
roles.line: Sets product direction for the managers who report to them. Reports to the Chief Product Officer.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.line: Decides what ships next inside the agreed roadmap and writes the PRD. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Head of Engineering
roles.line: Leads the engineering organisation. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.line: Sets the team's engineering standards and delivers working, tested increments. Reports to the Head of Engineering.

roles.title: Tech Lead
roles.line: Sets the technical approach for a team. Reports to the Engineering Manager.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.line: Delivers tested, reviewed code for the agreed design. Reports to the Engineering Manager.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.line: Checks that a build behaves as it should. Reports to the Engineering Manager.
roles.note: Also Test Automation Engineer

roles.title: Technical Architect
roles.line: Sets technical design patterns for services. Reports to the Head of Engineering.

roles.title: Solutions Architect
roles.line: Designs end-to-end technical solutions for business problems across systems. Reports to the Head of Engineering.

roles.title: Security Architect
roles.line: Designs secure solutions and advises on security risk. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or the CISO where one exists

roles.title: Cyber Security Analyst
roles.line: Monitors threats, investigates incidents and keeps the security risk register. Reports to the Security Architect.
roles.note: Also Information Security Analyst or SOC Analyst. Or the CISO where one exists

roles.title: Service Desk Manager
roles.line: Runs the service desk against SLAs and prepares it for new services. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Also IT Service Desk Manager or Head of Service Desk

roles.title: IT Service Manager
roles.line: Agrees IT service levels and runs service change and improvement. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or the Head of IT. Also IT Manager or IT Operations Manager

roles.title: Change and Release Manager
roles.line: Chairs the change advisory board and schedules technical changes and releases. Reports to the IT Service Manager.
roles.note: Or Head of Engineering where no IT Service Manager exists. Also Change Manager or Release Manager

roles.title: Service Desk Analyst
roles.line: Resolves IT requests and incidents at the first line. Reports to the Service Desk Manager.
roles.note: Also IT Support Analyst or IT Service Analyst

roles.title: Infrastructure Engineer
roles.line: Builds and runs the network, servers and cloud services. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Also Cloud Engineer, Network Engineer or Network Administrator

roles.title: Database Administrator
roles.line: Keeps databases available, secure and backed up for the people who need them. Reports to the Head of Engineering.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.line: Builds, deploys and monitors machine learning models in live products. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or Head of Data where one exists. Also ML Engineer or MLOps Engineer

roles.title: Head of Delivery
roles.line: Owns delivery across projects. Reports to the COO.

roles.title: Product Director
roles.line: Sets product direction for the managers who report to them. Reports to the Chief Product Officer.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.line: Decides what ships next inside the agreed roadmap and writes the PRD. Reports to the Product Director.

roles.title: Operations Manager
roles.line: Runs the operation across sites. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Across depots; one site is the Depot Manager

roles.title: Depot Manager
roles.line: Runs one site. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Also Site Manager

roles.title: Operations Analyst
roles.line: Reads how the operation is performing. Reports to the Operations Director.

roles.title: Procurement Manager
roles.line: Sources suppliers and awards contracts within delegated limits. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Or the Finance Director where procurement sits under finance

roles.title: Category Manager
roles.line: Owns the strategy and sourcing plan for an assigned spend category. Reports to the Procurement Manager.
roles.note: Also Category Lead

roles.title: Contracts Manager
roles.line: Manages supplier contracts after award: SLAs, KPIs, renewals and change. Reports to the Procurement Manager.

roles.title: Health and Safety Manager
roles.line: Sets safety procedures, investigates incidents and makes RIDDOR reports. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Also Health and Safety Adviser

roles.title: Quality Manager
roles.line: Runs the quality management system, audits and corrective actions. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Also Quality Assurance Manager or Head of Quality

roles.title: Facilities Manager
roles.line: Keeps buildings, assets and contracted services safe and within budget. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Also Estates Manager, Support Services Manager or FM Contract Manager

roles.title: Office Manager
roles.line: Runs day-to-day office operations, the office budget and admin staff. Reports to the Operations Director.
roles.note: Or the CEO in a smaller firm. Also Administration Manager or Business Manager

roles.title: Warehouse Manager
roles.line: Runs stock, storage and dispatch safely at a warehouse. Reports to the Operations Manager.
roles.note: Or the Depot Manager on a shared site. Also Distribution Centre Manager

roles.title: Transport Manager
roles.line: Keeps the fleet legal and on time under the operator licence. Reports to the Operations Manager.
roles.note: Or the Depot Manager on a shared site. Also Road Transport Manager

roles.title: Retail Manager
roles.line: Runs a store against sales, labour and brand standards. Reports to the Operations Manager.
roles.note: Or a Regional / Area Manager. Also Store Manager or Shopkeeper

roles.title: Financial Controller
roles.line: Keeps the accounts and the month-end close. Reports to the Finance Director.

roles.title: Finance Business Partner
roles.line: Works the numbers with one part of the business. Reports to the Finance Director.

roles.title: Head of Engineering
roles.line: Leads the engineering organisation. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.line: Builds and maintains the data pipelines that analysts and data scientists rely on. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or the Head of Data where one exists

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.line: Builds statistical and machine learning models to answer business questions. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or the Head of Data where one exists

roles.title: Data Architect
roles.line: Sets the data models and standards that pipelines and reports are built to. Reports to the Head of Engineering.
roles.note: Or Head of Data where one exists. Also Senior Data Architect or Enterprise Data Architect

roles.title: Payroll Manager
roles.line: Runs an accurate, on-time payroll and reports it to HMRC. Reports to the Financial Controller.
roles.note: Or the Head of People where payroll sits in HR

roles.title: Management Accountant
roles.line: Delivers management accounts, forecasts and variance analysis. Reports to the Financial Controller.
roles.note: Also Chartered Management Accountant

roles.title: Credit Controller
roles.line: Sets credit limits within policy and recovers overdue balances. Reports to the Financial Controller.
roles.note: Also Debt Collection Agent

roles.title: Bookkeeper
roles.line: Keeps the ledgers, reconciles the bank and prepares VAT returns. Reports to the Financial Controller.
roles.note: Also Accounts Clerk or Accounts Payable Clerk

roles.title: Tax Manager
roles.line: Files company tax returns, schedules tax payments and deals with HMRC. Reports to the Finance Director.
roles.note: Or a Head of Tax in a larger group. Also Corporate Tax Manager or Tax Adviser

roles.title: Treasury Manager
roles.line: Manages cash, bank facilities and currency and interest-rate risk within policy. Reports to the Finance Director.
roles.note: Or a Group Treasurer in a larger group. Also Corporate Treasurer or Head of Treasury

teams.title: Executive office, people, legal and marketing
teams.note: Where a Head of People exists, the HR Business Partner reports to them.

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.line: Prepares the board and keeps the executive team's priorities in one place. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Executive Assistant
roles.line: Runs a senior executive's diary, travel and meeting logistics. Reports to the CEO.
roles.note: Or the senior executive they support. Also EA, Personal Assistant or PA

roles.title: HR Business Partner
roles.line: Advises on people process and reports headcount, turnover, and absence. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
roles.line: Attracts and assesses candidates for approved vacancies. Reports to the HR Business Partner.
roles.note: Also Resourcing Manager. Where a Head of People exists, reports to them

roles.title: Learning and Development Business Partner
roles.line: Plans training against business priorities and measures its impact. Reports to the HR Business Partner.
roles.note: Also L&D Consultant or L&D Manager. Where a Head of People exists, reports to them

roles.title: Reward Manager
roles.line: Sets pay within the structure, runs the pay review and owns benefits. Reports to the HR Business Partner.
roles.note: Where a Head of People exists, to them. Also Reward and Benefits Manager

roles.title: Employee Relations Manager
roles.line: Runs disciplinary, grievance and consultation cases fairly and lawfully. Reports to the HR Business Partner.
roles.note: Or the Head of People where one exists. Also Employee Relations Lead or Head of Employee Relations

roles.title: Marketing Manager
roles.line: Spends the approved marketing budget and delivers qualified leads. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Manager
roles.line: Runs search, social and email channels and reports their return. Reports to the Marketing Manager.
roles.note: Also Digital Marketer, SEO Manager or Social Media Manager

roles.title: Market Research Manager
roles.line: Designs and runs customer and market research and turns it into insight. Reports to the Marketing Manager.
roles.note: Or a Head of Insight where one exists. Also Insight Manager or Consumer Insight Manager

roles.title: Events Manager
roles.line: Plans and runs conferences, exhibitions and business events to budget and on the day. Reports to the Marketing Manager.

roles.title: Fundraising Manager
roles.line: Plans and runs a charity's fundraising across donors, trusts, companies and events. Reports to the CEO.
roles.note: Or a Director of Fundraising in a larger charity. Also Head of Fundraising or Development Manager

roles.title: Communications Manager
roles.line: Protects reputation through media, statements and crisis playbooks. Reports to the CEO.
roles.note: Or Marketing Manager where marketing owns reputation. Also Public Relations Manager, PR Manager or Head of Communications

roles.title: Sustainability Manager
roles.line: Sets the sustainability action plan and evidence for disclosures. Reports to the CEO.
roles.note: Or Operations Director where sustainability sits in operations. Also Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner or Sustainability Officer

roles.title: Legal Counsel
roles.line: Reviews contracts before anyone signs. Reports to the General Counsel.

roles.title: Paralegal
roles.line: Researches, drafts and keeps legal matters on track for the lawyers. Reports to Legal Counsel.
roles.note: Or a supervising solicitor in a law firm. Also Legal Assistant or Contracts Assistant

roles.title: Internal Auditor
roles.line: Gives independent assurance on risk, governance and controls to the Audit Committee. Reports to the Audit Committee.
roles.note: Functionally to the Audit Committee; administratively to the CEO or Finance Director. Also Internal Audit Manager

roles.title: Risk Manager
roles.line: Keeps the risk register and reports the top risks to the board. Reports to the Finance Director.
roles.note: Or the Chief Risk Officer where one exists. Also Enterprise Risk Manager

roles.title: Business Continuity Manager
roles.line: Keeps continuity plans current and tested for every critical service. Reports to the Risk Manager.
roles.note: Or the COO or CIO where resilience sits in operations or IT. Also Business Continuity and Resilience Manager or Operational Resilience Manager

roles.title: Company Secretary
roles.line: Runs board papers and minutes and keeps Companies House filings current. Reports to the CEO.
roles.note: And to the Chair on board matters. Also Chartered Secretary or Governance Officer

roles.title: Product Director
roles.line: Sets product direction for the managers who report to them. Reports to the Chief Product Officer.

roles.title: Money Laundering Reporting Officer
roles.line: Receives internal suspicion reports and decides what goes to the NCA. The focal point for anti-money laundering. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Financial Crime Investigator
roles.line: Investigates transaction monitoring alerts and passes evidenced suspicions to the MLRO. Reports to the Money Laundering Reporting Officer.

roles.title: KYC Analyst
roles.line: Identifies and verifies customers and their owners before onboarding, and keeps due diligence current. Reports to the Money Laundering Reporting Officer.

teams.title: Risk and compliance (three lines of defence)

roles.title: Chief Risk Officer
roles.line: Runs the independent risk function and reports the firm's risk profile against appetite. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Compliance Officer
roles.line: Runs the independent compliance function, its monitoring programme and reporting to the board. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: CASS Oversight Officer
roles.line: Oversees how client money and assets are protected, and reports on it to the board. Reports to the Compliance Officer.

roles.title: Internal Auditor
roles.line: Gives independent assurance on risk, governance and controls (third line). Reports to the Audit Committee.

roles.title: Customer Operations Manager
roles.line: Runs customer operations and complaints, and fixes the root causes behind them. Reports to the CEO.

roles.title: Complaints Handler
roles.line: Investigates and answers customer complaints within the regulatory time limits. Reports to the Customer Operations Manager.

roles.title: Support Agent
roles.line: Answers customer questions and resolves day-to-day issues. Reports to the Head of Customer Success.

roles.title: Financial Adviser
roles.line: Gives personal financial advice once the client's suitability information is complete. Reports to the Head of Advice.

roles.title: Paraplanner
roles.line: Researches and drafts suitability reports for the adviser to sign off. Reports to the Financial Adviser.
